env.service: UNMAPPED_SERVICE_TEST=1 bun run service -- --port 8797 --data $SCR/service-data (a fresh empty dir)
env.page: bun run browser:dev  (Vite, http://localhost:5190, the dev CSP that allows loopback)
env.world: bun --tsconfig-override tsconfig.node.json scripts/seed-shared-world.ts make --service ws://127.0.0.1:8797 --out $SCR/seed → prints the invite link that replaces __INVITE__
env.viewport: 375 × 812, deviceScaleFactor 2, mobile with touch emulation (each run starts with {viewport}; emulation lasts one DevTools session)
env.input: After the first shot: touch only (tap, tapText, drag on the on-screen stick, tap on A) and typed text into the focused field; evals are read-only probes (they read the page and IndexedDB) except the ones that scroll to the top and blur, which a player does by scrolling and tapping empty space.

part: A — join from an invite, move focus with the touch stick, choose with A, leave a note

actions.eval: JSON.stringify({link: [...document.querySelectorAll('span')].map(s => s.innerText).find(t => /^(Online|Offline|Connecting|Stopped|The service refused)/.test(t)) ?? null, sync: document.body.innerText.split('\n').find(l => /^Entry /.test(l)) ?? null, notes: document.body.innerText.split('\n').filter(l => /^— /.test(l) || /shallow|phone|heron|network/.test(l)), onLine: navigator.onLine})

new Promise((resolve) => { const open = indexedDB.open('unmapped-browser'); open.onsuccess = () => { const db = open.result; const tx = db.transaction(['meta', 'worlds', 'entries', 'outbox'], 'readonly'); const out = {}; const key = tx.objectStore('meta').get('device-keys'); key.onsuccess = () => { out.key = key.result && { algorithm: key.result.privateKey.algorithm.name, extractable: key.result.privateKey.extractable, usages: key.result.privateKey.usages }; }; const worlds = tx.objectStore('worlds').getAll(); worlds.onsuccess = () => { out.worlds = worlds.result.map((w) => ({ id: w.id.slice(0, 12), url: w.url, name: w.name, diverged: w.diverged, refused: w.refused.length })); }; const entries = tx.objectStore('entries').count(); entries.onsuccess = () => { out.entries = entries.result; }; const outbox = tx.objectStore('outbox').getAll(); outbox.onsuccess = () => { out.outbox = outbox.result.map((row) => row.events.length); }; tx.oncomplete = () => resolve(JSON.stringify(out)); }; open.onerror = () => resolve('no db'); })
